experiment_data.hypothesis: N=17 target models (vs N=8) with 7 diverse judges provides sufficient statistical power for G-MFRM joint estimation to achieve significant Δτ over baselines, confirming that exp-018 synthetic calibration results translate to real data.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias && python -u run_mcmc_n17_exp020_v2.py --warmup 6000 --samples 4000 --chains 4 2>&1 | tee logs/exp020_mcmc_v2.log"

experiment_data.notes: MCMC v2 launched with NCP (non-centered b_i + theta_n). PID 58562, GPU 0, autodl-8gpu. Warmup 6000, samples 4000, chains 4. ETA ~90 min. v1 killed due to convergence failure (R̂=2.90). v2 dry-run passed (R̂ max=1.02, ESS min=719).
